core_obligations: Identify the degreewise building blocks: for every object W of the category the evaluation functor F -> F(W) is an additive exact functor from abelian presheaves to abelian groups (proof lines 932-934).
Use that products of exact functors are exact: the degree p term C^p-check(U, F) of the Cech complex is a product of such evaluation functors, hence exact (proof lines 935-936).

Pass from terms to complexes: a sequence of complexes is exact exactly when the sequence of its terms in each fixed degree is exact, so exactness of the Cech complex functor follows (proof lines 937-938).
proof_roadmap: Note exactness of each evaluation functor (proof lines 932-934).
Observe that the terms of the Cech complex are products of evaluation functors and hence exact (proof lines 935-936).
Conclude exactness of the functor on complexes from degreewise exactness (proof lines 937-938).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the functor assigning to an abelian presheaf its Cech complex with respect to a fixed family is exact (statement lines 927-928). The proof is three lines of structural reasoning but each step is a different category-theoretic fact: evaluation at an object is exact, a product of exact functors is exact, and a sequence of complexes is exact exactly when it is exact in each degree (proof lines 932-938). The second step is what makes the statement useful, since the higher Cech terms are products rather than finite direct sums. The claim is H2: short, no constructions, but a correct assembly of three separate exactness facts.
